Payment

Payment footers allow you to add customized text at the bottom of payment forms to document important information about each transaction.

You can create multiple footer templates for different payment scenarios, such as bank transfers, checks, or electronic payments.

Each footer template can be selected when recording a payment, ensuring the appropriate documentation appears on the payment record.

Understanding Payment Footers

Footers are text sections that appear at the bottom of your payment forms, providing space to document important payment details and authorization information.

Common uses for payment footers include:

• Payment authorization codes or approval signatures

• Bank transfer reference numbers and wire instructions

• Remittance advice for suppliers

• Internal control notes or approval workflows

• Check numbers or electronic payment confirmations

Creating Footer Templates

You can create multiple footer templates and select the appropriate one when recording each payment transaction.

This flexibility allows you to maintain proper documentation standards while accommodating different payment methods, approval requirements, or supplier preferences.

When creating a footer template, enter a descriptive name that clearly identifies its purpose. Examples include:

• Wire Transfer Instructions - for payments requiring bank routing details

• Check Payment Authorization - for payments made by check

• ACH Payment Confirmation - for electronic transfers

• Petty Cash Reimbursement - for small cash payments
